title: Palindrome Callouts
prompt:
For each input line, print `YES` if it is a palindrome and `NO` otherwise.

Only letters and digits count, and case doesn't matter. `Race car!` is a palindrome. A line with no letters or digits at all counts as a palindrome.

tests.name: several
tests.input:
A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
what a save

tutorNotes: Trains char.IsLetterOrDigit, char.ToLowerInvariant, and either a two-pointer loop or building a filtered string and comparing with its reverse. A two-pointer approach without allocations is the strongest follow-up question. Watch for index out of range when both pointers skip non-alphanumeric characters without bounds checks.
